title: Step 2 - Labelled training set and final model
intro:
Builds the labelled set MMS1 + THA + THB + C1 and trains the final model: an ensemble of HistGradientBoosting classifiers (max_iter=404, max_leaf_nodes=342), one per feature set given by `choose_best_features()` (feature sets with precision > 0.83 and recall > 0.821 in `all_precisions.pkl` / `all_recalls.pkl`); the prediction is the mean probability.

Inputs: `labelled_MMS1_THA_THB_2025-06-10.pkl` (MMS1, THA, THB labelled points), `C1_interesting_for_BL_extended.pkl` and the C1 label catalogues of 2025-08-04.

Outputs: `{OUT}/labelled_MMS1_THA_THB_C1.pkl` and `{OUT}/model_MMS_THEMIS_Cluster.pkl`.

**Note**: the model used in step 3 is the frozen file `/home/ghisalberti/GradientBoosting/diagnostics/model_MMS_THEMIS_Cluster.pkl`. Retraining does not give exactly the same model (HistGradientBoosting uses a random validation split for early stopping), and the exact training file of 2025-09-15 is lost: the file `labelled_MMS1_THA_THB_C1.pkl` was rewritten on 2026-04-13 with only 66432 of the 82515 C1 rows, and the code that wrote it is lost. Here the dated file of cell 18 is used as the training set.

title: Step 3 - Apply the model and build the BL dataset
intro:
Applies the final model (`model_MMS_THEMIS_Cluster.pkl`, trained on MMS1+THA+THB+C1) to the 8 satellites, selects the BL points (pred_BL > 0.5), finds the closest clean MSP and MSH points (cusps cut Bz>=-50 nT on both, Np>=3 on MSH), averages their features, merges the satellites and adds the propagated OMNI values.

Inputs: `/DATA/ghisalberti/Datasets/{mission}/{sat}/{sat}_interesting_for_BL.pkl` (step 1), the model files in `/home/ghisalberti/GradientBoosting/diagnostics/`, OMNI files in `/DATA/ghisalberti/Datasets/OMNI/OMNI/`.

Output: `{OUT}/BL_MMS1_THEMIS_Cluster_without_cusps_withoutNp<3_all_sat_1min_2025-05-06.pkl`.

Note: `date_model='2025-05-06'` is only a label in file names, and the 2025-05-06 model file is read only for the list of features used in `dropna`.

title: Step 4 - BL depth and final map dataset
intro:
Computes the BL depth from the ion spectra (distance to the neighbouring MSP and MSH spectra, `compute_depth`), its global rank-uniformization (`uniform_depthonly_spectro`, used by the maps) and its local one, the dipole tilt, and saves the 28 columns used by the maps.

Input: output of step 3. Output: `{OUT}/BL_data_for_maps_without_cusps_withoutNp<3_all_sat_1min_2025-05-06.pkl`.

title: Step 5 - BL maps and X-line
intro:
Maps of dVz = Vz - Vz_MSH in the external BL (`uniform_depthonly_spectro > 0.83`), projected on the magnetopause, for a given IMF clock angle (gaussian weights, std 30°) and dipole tilt (std 10°): weighted KNN (`knn_weighted_feature_map`). The X-line is the dVz = 0 line where the flow diverges (`find_stagnation_line`, sigma=7).

Input: output of step 4. Outputs: `{OUT}/xlines/DeltaVz_cla{cla}_tilt{tilt}.pkl` (169 files) and `{OUT}/xlines/DeltaVz_cla{cla}.pkl` (13 files), used by step 6, and the paper figures in `{OUT}/figures/`.

`prepare_data`, `get_weights_gaussian` and `knn_weighted_feature_map` were defined in FinalMapsPaper cell 2 with the same code as in swapp; they are imported from `blxline.maps`.
